# Nuqra

> Nuqra (نقرة) is QR scan-to-pay for restaurants in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

Diners scan a QR code at their table, view the bill, split it any way they
like, add a tip, and pay — no app download required.

Restaurants pay a flat fee per branch, not a percentage of the bill total.

Nuqra is Arabic-first: both the diner-facing flow and the admin dashboard
support Arabic and English, with full RTL layout.

Nuqra runs alongside a restaurant's existing POS system rather than
replacing it.

A 7-day free trial with no card required is available at
https://nuqra.org/demo.
